import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# According to operation_history, perform UNION of all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema: ['Name', 'Team', 'Position', 'SnapsPlayed']
# So we can concatenate them directly

target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# Target Schema: ['Name': string, 'Team': string, 'Position': string, 'SnapsPlayed': integer]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
target_df['Name'] = target_df['Name'].astype(str)
target_df['Team'] = target_df['Team'].astype(str)
target_df['Position'] = target_df['Position'].astype(str)
target_df['SnapsPlayed'] = target_df['SnapsPlayed'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
